population_and_split_contract.primary_split: exact frozen shot IDs from each published baseline for reproduction; do not regenerate or mix split strategies
population_and_split_contract.if_negative_shots_unavailable: report false-alarm rates as undefined; do not substitute zero

published_robustness_reproduction.description: Reproduce the pinned Neerav-Gupta TokaMark robustness repository against its exact saved test cohort and saved model/data artifacts

tokamind_gentoka_group6_reproduction.description: Reproduce the paper-defined shared Group-6 held-out cohort, window grid, nested input schemas, Soft-TTD labels and validation-selected common threshold

tokamark_temporal_transfer.description: Pinned TokaMark temporal campaign split: train and validation use M5/M6/M7 plus Unknown; test is exclusively the later M8 and M9 campaigns
tokamark_temporal_transfer.test_policy: M8 and M9 are held out as future campaigns; never tune preprocessing, thresholds, warning interval, persistence or calibration on this test cohort
tokamark_temporal_transfer.split_semantics: campaign-forward holdout; campaign label Unknown remains in train/validation only

matching_preprocessing_assets.policy: use temporal split-specific normalization statistics and outlier metadata; never combine with random split assets

tokamark_random_split.description: Secondary in-distribution random shot split (80/10/10) for comparability with conventional benchmark practice

online_policy_contract.policy_config_sha256: computed from exact policy ID, score scale ID, validation receipt, threshold bit patterns, persistence counts and required warning interval

uncertainty_semantics.otherwise: uncertain; preserve current alert state and reset persistence counters

risk_score_contract.interval_coverage_claim: nominal method metadata only; empirical coverage must be reported on held-out data
risk_score_contract.evidence_digest: SHA-256 content identity only; not source/model/calibration authenticity proof
risk_score_contract.threshold_scale_identity: risk evidence score_scale_id must exactly match frozen policy score_scale_id; all values must fall within frozen inclusive score_min/score_max
risk_score_contract.score_domain_policy: risk evidence lower_bound and upper_bound must both be inside frozen policy [score_min, score_max]; policy thresholds must also lie in that closed interval

online_policy_contract.policy_config_digest_encoding: length-prefixed UTF-8 fields plus exact IEEE-754 threshold bit patterns; delimiter characters in IDs cannot create ambiguous field boundaries; includes exact model artifact, training split, calibration identity/receipt, uncertainty method and nominal coverage; includes maximum allowed warning lead time; includes inclusive numeric score_min and score_max using exact IEEE-754 bit patterns

rolling_inference_contract.input_rule: for each cut time, use only the previous 100 ms of observations strictly before or at that cut
rolling_inference_contract.execution_rule: re-run the fixed model/policy on each chronological cut with updated measured context; do not condition a cut on later windows or t_cut
rolling_inference_contract.paper_comparison_note: GenToka uses one conditional pass to generate a complete output window; this benchmark's rolling mode is repeated causal inference at successive cuts, not a claim that the published model itself is autoregressive

score_domain.semantics: all trigger/clear thresholds, point estimates and uncertainty bounds must lie inside this declared closed interval

alarm_episode_trace_contract.episode_start: only transition into Raised emits an alarm episode timestamp
transitions_refused: Uncertain/Abstained whose alert_remains_active disagrees with trace state
alarm_episode_trace_contract.output: one strictly increasing timestamp per transition into Raised, plus shot ID and frozen policy digest

offline_scoring_contract.confidence_intervals: Wilson score 95% intervals for event TPR and false-alarm-shot rate; for multi-machine or event-class subgroup aggregates, add a shot-level stratified bootstrap and report the resampling seed
offline_scoring_contract.undefined_metrics: return null when the denominator cohort is empty

false_alarm_rate_denominators.per_shot: false alarm episodes from non-disruptive shots divided by non-disruptive shots; out-of-window episodes on disruptive shots are reported separately
false_alarm_rate_denominators.per_hour: sum of non-disruptive shot exposure durations in hours
false_alarm_rate_denominators.alarm_events: timestamps at which the online policy transitions into Raised

offline_scoring_contract.alarms_outside_warning_interval: count as false alarm episodes; they do not satisfy event detection

warning_interval.maximum_ns: validation-selected and frozen in policy; must be >= minimum
warning_interval.event_detected_when: at least one alarm episode has t_cut - alarm_time in [minimum_ns, maximum_ns]
warning_interval.alarm_episode_matching: exactly one in-window alarm episode may match the disruption; all other episodes are false alarms
warning_interval.too_early: alarm lead time > max_warning_ns counts as false alarm and cannot satisfy event detection
warning_interval.too_late: alarm lead time < required_warning_ns counts as false alarm and cannot satisfy event detection

evaluation_receipt_contract.bootstrap_interval_policy: when supplied, the receipt stores the deterministic shot-cluster plan and recomputes its exposure-normalized false-alarm interval from the exact ordered per-shot alarm records

published_toka_mark_robustness.status: paper_and_repository_reported; not independently reproduced by Symthaea

gen_toka_group6.status: paper_reported_results; no public GenToka repository or checkpoint was located in the current search; exact reproduction is blocked on artifact availability
comparison_notes: GenToka improves F1 on all three nested input schemas but has slightly lower macro AUROC than TokaMind
F1 uses a validation-selected common threshold of 0.4 and Soft-TTD windows with target >= 0.5 are positive
Window-level F1/AUROC are not interchangeable with shot-level event TPR, false alarms per hour or warning-time distributions
architecture_limitations: GenToka generates a complete requested output window in one conditional pass, rather than advancing autoregressively with updated context
Published Group-6 AUROC and F1 are window-level and do not by themselves establish shot-level event TPR, false alarms per hour, or warning-time compliance
The published 100 ms history and 10 ms cut grid provide a reproducible rolling evaluation grid; each cut must use causal pre-anchor history

synthetic_replay_interop.downstream_rule: synthetic replay observations must abstain at a direct-measurement decision gate; they may be used only in explicitly synthetic robustness/research paths
synthetic_replay_interop.claim_ceiling: synthetic perturbation and evidence-state mapping only; no physical measurement, diagnostic accuracy, instrument failure-rate, observability, or safety claim
synthetic_replay_interop.consumer_gate_test: deserialize each frame as PlasmaObservationFrame and require DecisionInputGate::Abstain with exact SyntheticNotMeasurement, Unavailable, or Invalid reason

window_level_metrics.draws_per_replicate: N unique held-out shot IDs with replacement
window_level_metrics.confidence_interval: 95% percentile interval over shot-cluster bootstrap replicates
window_level_metrics.sampling_rule: when a shot ID is sampled, include every benchmark window belonging to that shot; repeated shot IDs duplicate the entire window cluster
window_level_metrics.paired_model_comparison: evaluate both models on the exact same shot-cluster bootstrap index vector per replicate; report paired model-B-minus-model-A deltas and the 95% percentile interval
window_level_metrics.forbidden: resampling individual windows independently or treating windows from one shot as independent observations

paired_metric_delta_bootstrap.method: paired 95% percentile bootstrap over whole shot clusters
paired_metric_delta_bootstrap.callback_receives: shot indices with replacement; caller expands each index to all windows for that shot, preserving multiplicity
paired_metric_delta_bootstrap.undefined_or_non_finite_replicate: fail closed; do not silently drop undefined metrics

shot_level_event_metrics.method: Wilson score intervals for event TPR and false-alarm shot rate
shot_level_event_metrics.false_alarm_per_hour: report point rate with negative-shot exposure; when at least 95% of the frozen shot-cluster bootstrap replicates have non-zero negative exposure, attach a recomputed 95% percentile interval; otherwise report interval as undefined

plan_requirements: bind plan to exact dataset revision ID
bind plan to ordered shot-ID list digest
bind plan to seed, replicate count and RNG algorithm revision
verify plan digest before evaluating models
record plan SHA-256 in every benchmark result receipt
